mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as accommodative monetary policy reduces equity discount rates and supports risk asset valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and declines in housing starts (HOUST) signal a contractionary demand shock that reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and HOUST falls, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of high inflation periods, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force participation rate (as measured by PAYEMS growth) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as stronger job growth supports consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95 in a 3-month average, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction that reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 and RSAFS both decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO decline), industrial output contraction reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as profit margins compress.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is declining, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
